use_case_name: Generate Treatment Quality and Trend Reports

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User generates bi-monthly or monthly financial and medical reports to arrange payments for VSPs and track treatment data.

goal.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User generates bi-monthly or monthly financial and medical reports to arrange payments for VSPs and track treatment data.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
Payment terms (Bi-Monthly or Monthly) must be agreed upon and captured in the VSP Master Information screen.
Claims must be submitted by the VSP to the MSIU Field Office with all mandatory information complete.
Claim forms must be validated manually and through the system; rejected claims with missing or false information are quarantined and not included until resolved.
Reports are generated after claim collection, distinguishing between clean claims to be paid and claims where payment is withheld pending clarification.
The MSIU Field Office User initiates the generation of bi-monthly or monthly financial and medical reports based on the agreed payment terms after the claim collection period concludes.

trigger.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User initiates the generation of bi-monthly or monthly financial and medical reports based on the agreed payment terms after the claim collection period concludes.

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User validates each submitted claim form manually and through the system.
If mandatory information is missing or false information exists, the Field Office User rejects the claim and the system places it in a quarantine area.
Quarantined claim forms are sent back to the VSP for verification and correction.
If the VSP returns the claim with satisfactory details, the Field Office User enters the corrected claim into the system in the following month’s batch.
Based on the agreed payment terms (Bi-Monthly or Monthly), the Field Office User generates the financial and medical report.
The generated report is sent to the MSIU Admin team to arrange payments for the VSP.

If the VSP returns a quarantined claim with satisfactory details after verification, the Field Office User enters the corrected claim into the system in the following month's batch instead of the current reporting cycle.
If mandatory information is missing or false information exists during claim validation, the Field Office rejects the claim back to the VSP, and the system keeps those claims in a quarantine area.
Quarantined forms are sent back to the VSP for verification; if the VSP returns the claim with satisfactory details, the claims are entered into the system in the following month's batch.
The system generates a monthly report on claims where payment shall be withheld until clarification, separate from the report on clean claims to be paid without reservation.
The system includes a Claim Quarantine / Rejection Reason Master with Reason Code and Reason Description to track why claims are quarantined or rejected.
The system only accepts claims if the mandatory information is complete; otherwise, they are not processed for payment reporting.
The generated financial and medical report is sent to the MSIU Admin team to arrange payments for the VSP.
A monthly report on clean claims to be paid without reservation is produced after claim collection.
A monthly report on claims where payment shall be withheld until clarification is produced separately from the clean claims report.
